sandbachFocus: Sandbach United face a tough away trip to New Mills on Tuesday night at 7:45pm. The Bach will be looking to bounce back after their disappointing 3-2 midweek defeat at Foley Meir, where they squandered numerous chances. New Mills also suffered a heavy 5-0 loss to Stafford Town last week, so both teams will be desperate to rediscover winning form in what promises to be an intense local fixture.
divisionWide: Wolverhampton Casuals continue their impressive start with a home clash against Eccleshall on Wednesday at 19:45—both teams have strong records so far (Casuals unbeaten, Eccleshall 2-1). Stafford Town travel to Alsager Town on Tuesday seeking to maintain momentum after their emphatic 5-0 demolition of New Mills. Barnton host struggling Cheadle Heath Nomads at home on Wednesday (19:45), with Barnton looking to build on their comeback win over Eccleshall. In a local derby, Allscott Heath welcome Shawbury United on Wednesday night at the Peter Ford Stadium. Crewe and Foley Meir clash in an 8pm Tuesday encounter as both teams look for consistency. AFC Bridgnorth, unbeaten at the top, travel to Wednesfield on Tuesday—a potential title-race indicator. Telford Town make the short trip to Market Drayton for another local derby on Tuesday evening.
